# First 500 numbers: mean = 0, standard deviation = 1

# Last 500 numbers: mean = 1, standard deviation = 2

# Combine them into one sequence of 1,000 numbers
my_data <- c(normal_part, anomaly_part)

```{r}
#Robustified CUSUM
# Step 2:  Robustified CUSUM Method

robust_cusum_fixed <- function(x, delta = 1.5, burn_in = 50, threshold = 5) {
  
  # Huber's psi function (ignores extreme outliers)
psi_huber <- function(u, c = 1.345) {
  ifelse(abs(u) <= c, u, c * sign(u))
}
  n <- length(x)
  mu_hat <- numeric(n)      # stores estimated mean over time
  sigma_hat <- numeric(n)   # stores estimated standard deviation over time
  S <- numeric(n)           # stores the CUSUM alarm statistic
  
  # Start with first observation
  mu_hat[1] <- x[1]
  sigma_hat[1] <- 1
  S[1] <- 0
  
  # Process observations one by one
  for (t in 2:n) {
    # Standardized residual
    r <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    
    # Update mean estimate (recursive M-estimator)
    psi_val <- psi_huber(r)
    mu_hat[t] <- mu_hat[t-1] + (1/t) * psi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]
    
    # Update standard deviation estimate (robust scale)
    chi_val <- psi_val^2 / 0.6827  # 0.6827 = expected value for normal
    sigma_hat[t] <- sqrt(sigma_hat[t-1]^2 + (1/(t-1)) * (chi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]^2 - sigma_hat[t-1]^2))
    
    # Update CUSUM alarm statistic
    r_new <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    # Only start monitoring after burn-in period
    if (t > burn_in) {
      S[t] <- max(0, S[t-1] + r_new - delta)
    } else {
      S[t] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  return(S)
}
# Run with burn-in period
result_fixed <- robust_cusum_fixed(my_data, delta = 1.5, burn_in = 50, threshold = 5)

# Find first alarm after burn-in
alarm_indices <- which(result_fixed > 5)
alarm_indices[1]

```

```{r}
# ============================================
# Full Simulation: 1,000 Runs
# Robustified CUSUM with Burn-in
# ============================================

# Clear and set seed for reproducibility
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(123)

# Parameters
n_sim <- 1000          # number of simulations
n <- 1000              # observations per simulation
change_point <- 500    # anomaly starts here
burn_in <- 50          # wait 50 observations before monitoring
threshold <- 5         # alarm threshold
delta <- 1.5           # CUSUM reference value

# Store results
detection_delays <- c()

# Define the robust CUSUM function
robust_cusum_fixed <- function(x, delta = 1.5, burn_in = 50) {
  
  psi_huber <- function(u, c = 1.345) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= c, u, c * sign(u))
  }
  
  n <- length(x)
  mu_hat <- numeric(n)
  sigma_hat <- numeric(n)
  S <- numeric(n)
  
  mu_hat[1] <- x[1]
  sigma_hat[1] <- 1
  S[1] <- 0
  
  for (t in 2:n) {
    r <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    psi_val <- psi_huber(r)
    mu_hat[t] <- mu_hat[t-1] + (1/t) * psi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]
    chi_val <- psi_val^2 / 0.6827
    sigma_hat[t] <- sqrt(sigma_hat[t-1]^2 + (1/(t-1)) * (chi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]^2 - sigma_hat[t-1]^2))
    r_new <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    
    if (t > burn_in) {
      S[t] <- max(0, S[t-1] + r_new - delta)
    } else {
      S[t] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  return(S)
}

# Run simulations
cat("Starting", n_sim, "simulations...\n")
cat("This will take about 5-10 minutes\n\n")

for (i in 1:n_sim) {
  
  # Generate data for this simulation
  normal_part <- rnorm(change_point, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  anomaly_part <- rnorm(n - change_point, mean = 1, sd = 2)
  my_data <- c(normal_part, anomaly_part)
  
  # Run robust CUSUM
  S <- robust_cusum_fixed(my_data, delta = delta, burn_in = burn_in)
  
  # Find first alarm after anomaly starts (observation 500)
  S_after_change <- S[change_point:length(S)]
  alarm_index <- which(S_after_change > threshold)[1]
  
  if (!is.na(alarm_index)) {
    alarm_time <- change_point + alarm_index - 1
    delay <- alarm_time - change_point
    detection_delays <- c(detection_delays, delay)
  }
  
  # Show progress every 100 simulations
  if (i %% 100 == 0) {
    cat("Completed", i, "simulations\n")
  }
}

# Results
cat("\n========== RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("Number of successful detections:", length(detection_delays), "out of", n_sim, "\n")
cat("Average detection delay:", mean(detection_delays), "observations\n")
cat("Minimum detection delay:", min(detection_delays), "\n")
cat("Maximum detection delay:", max(detection_delays), "\n")
#standard deviation
sd(detection_delays)

```

```{r}
# Standard CUSUM function (for comparison)
standard_cusum <- function(x, delta = 0.5, burn_in = 50, threshold = 5) {
  
  n <- length(x)
  mu_hat <- numeric(n)
  sigma_hat <- numeric(n)
  S <- numeric(n)
  
  # Initial estimates from first 50 observations
  mu_hat[1:burn_in] <- mean(x[1:burn_in])
  sigma_hat[1:burn_in] <- sd(x[1:burn_in])
  S[1] <- 0
  
  for (t in (burn_in+1):n) {
    r <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    S[t] <- max(0, S[t-1] + r - delta)
  }
  
  return(S)
}

# Run standard CUSUM once to see if it works
my_data <- c(rnorm(500, mean = 0, sd = 1), rnorm(500, mean = 1, sd = 2))
S_standard <- standard_cusum(my_data, delta = 0.5, burn_in = 50, threshold = 5)

# Find first alarm after anomaly
S_after <- S_standard[500:1000]
alarm_index <- which(S_after > 5)[1]

if (!is.na(alarm_index)) {
  cat("Standard CUSUM alarm at observation:", 500 + alarm_index - 1, "\n")
} else {
  cat("Standard CUSUM never raised alarm\n")
}
# Check the standard CUSUM values
summary(S_standard)
```



```{r}
# ============================================
# Scenario 3: Pure Variance Change Simulation
# Mean stays constant (μ = 0)
# Variance increases: 1 -> 4 at t = 500
# ============================================

rm(list = ls())
set.seed(123)

# Parameters
n_sim <- 1000
n <- 1000
change_point <- 500
burn_in <- 50
threshold <- 5
delta <- 1.5

# Store results
detection_delays <- c()

# Define the robust CUSUM function
robust_cusum_fixed <- function(x, delta = 1.5, burn_in = 50) {
  
  psi_huber <- function(u, c = 1.345) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= c, u, c * sign(u))
  }
  
  n <- length(x)
  mu_hat <- numeric(n)
  sigma_hat <- numeric(n)
  S <- numeric(n)
  
  mu_hat[1] <- x[1]
  sigma_hat[1] <- 1
  S[1] <- 0
  
  for (t in 2:n) {
    r <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    psi_val <- psi_huber(r)
    mu_hat[t] <- mu_hat[t-1] + (1/t) * psi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]
    chi_val <- psi_val^2 / 0.6827
    sigma_hat[t] <- sqrt(sigma_hat[t-1]^2 + (1/(t-1)) * (chi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]^2 - sigma_hat[t-1]^2))
    r_new <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    
    if (t > burn_in) {
      S[t] <- max(0, S[t-1] + r_new - delta)
    } else {
      S[t] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  return(S)
}

# Run simulations
cat("Running 1,000 simulations for Pure Variance Change (μ stays 0, σ: 1 -> 2)...\n")

for (i in 1:n_sim) {
  
  # Generate pure variance change data
  # Mean is ALWAYS 0 (both before and after)
  normal_part <- rnorm(change_point, mean = 0, sd = 1)      # variance = 1
  anomaly_part <- rnorm(n - change_point, mean = 0, sd = 2) # variance = 4
  my_data <- c(normal_part, anomaly_part)
  
  # Run robust CUSUM
  S <- robust_cusum_fixed(my_data, delta = delta, burn_in = burn_in)
  
  # Find first alarm after anomaly starts
  S_after_change <- S[change_point:length(S)]
  alarm_index <- which(S_after_change > threshold)[1]
  
  if (!is.na(alarm_index)) {
    alarm_time <- change_point + alarm_index - 1
    delay <- alarm_time - change_point
    detection_delays <- c(detection_delays, delay)
  }
  
  if (i %% 100 == 0) {
    cat("Completed", i, "simulations\n")
  }
}

# Results
cat("\n========== RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("Successful detections:", length(detection_delays), "out of", n_sim, "\n")
cat("Average detection delay:", mean(detection_delays), "observations\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", round(sd(detection_delays), 2), "\n")
cat("Minimum delay:", min(detection_delays), "\n")
cat("Maximum delay:", max(detection_delays), "\n")

```

```{r}
#Scenario 4: Festival spike(UPI-like)
# Clear and set seed
rm(list = ls())
set.seed(123)

# Parameters
n <- 1000
change_point <- 500      # anomaly starts here
spike_end <- 600         # festival spike ends here

# Create empty data vector
my_data <- numeric(n)

# Generate data
for (t in 1:n) {
  if (t < change_point) {
    # Before anomaly: mean 0, sd 1
    my_data[t] <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = 1)
  } else if (t <= spike_end) {
    # During festival spike: mean 1, sd 3 (variance 9)
    my_data[t] <- rnorm(1, mean = 1, sd = 3)
  } else {
    # After spike: mean 1, sd 1 (variance back to 1)
    my_data[t] <- rnorm(1, mean = 1, sd = 1)
  }
}

# Look at first 20 and last 20
head(my_data, 20)
tail(my_data, 20)


# Your robust CUSUM function (same as before)
robust_cusum_fixed <- function(x, delta = 1.5, burn_in = 50, threshold = 5) {
  
  psi_huber <- function(u, c = 1.345) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= c, u, c * sign(u))
  }
  
  n <- length(x)
  mu_hat <- numeric(n)
  sigma_hat <- numeric(n)
  S <- numeric(n)
  
  mu_hat[1] <- x[1]
  sigma_hat[1] <- 1
  S[1] <- 0
  
  for (t in 2:n) {
    r <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    psi_val <- psi_huber(r)
    mu_hat[t] <- mu_hat[t-1] + (1/t) * psi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]
    chi_val <- psi_val^2 / 0.6827
    sigma_hat[t] <- sqrt(sigma_hat[t-1]^2 + (1/(t-1)) * (chi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]^2 - sigma_hat[t-1]^2))
    r_new <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    
    if (t > burn_in) {
      S[t] <- max(0, S[t-1] + r_new - delta)
    } else {
      S[t] <- 0
    }
  }
  
  return(S)
}


# Run robust CUSUM
result <- robust_cusum_fixed(my_data, delta = 1.5, burn_in = 50)

# Find first alarm after anomaly starts (observation 500)
S_after <- result[500:1000]
alarm_index <- which(S_after > 5)[1]

if (!is.na(alarm_index)) {
  alarm_time <- 500 + alarm_index - 1
  cat("Alarm raised at observation:", alarm_time, "\n")
  cat("Detection delay:", alarm_time - 500, "observations\n")
} else {
  cat("No alarm raised\n")
}
```


```{r}
# Full simulation for Scenario 4 (Festival Spike)

rm(list = ls())
set.seed(123)

n_sim <- 1000
n <- 1000
change_point <- 500
spike_end <- 600
burn_in <- 50
threshold <- 5
delta <- 1.5

detection_delays <- c()

# Define function
robust_cusum_fixed <- function(x, delta = 1.5, burn_in = 50) {
  
  psi_huber <- function(u, c = 1.345) {
    ifelse(abs(u) <= c, u, c * sign(u))
  }
  
  n <- length(x)
  mu_hat <- numeric(n)
  sigma_hat <- numeric(n)
  S <- numeric(n)
  
  mu_hat[1] <- x[1]
  sigma_hat[1] <- 1
  S[1] <- 0
  
  for (t in 2:n) {
    r <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    psi_val <- psi_huber(r)
    mu_hat[t] <- mu_hat[t-1] + (1/t) * psi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]
    chi_val <- psi_val^2 / 0.6827
    sigma_hat[t] <- sqrt(sigma_hat[t-1]^2 + (1/(t-1)) * (chi_val * sigma_hat[t-1]^2 - sigma_hat[t-1]^2))
    r_new <- (x[t] - mu_hat[t-1]) / sigma_hat[t-1]
    
    if (t > burn_in) {
      S[t] <- max(0, S[t-1] + r_new - delta)
    } else {
      S[t] <- 0
    }
  }
  return(S)
}

# Run simulations
cat("Running 1,000 simulations for Scenario 4 (Festival Spike)...\n")

for (i in 1:n_sim) {
  
  # Generate Scenario 4 data
  my_data <- numeric(n)
  for (t in 1:n) {
    if (t < change_point) {
      my_data[t] <- rnorm(1, mean = 0, sd = 1)
    } else if (t <= spike_end) {
      my_data[t] <- rnorm(1, mean = 1, sd = 3)
    } else {
      my_data[t] <- rnorm(1, mean = 1, sd = 1)
    }
  }
  
  # Run robust CUSUM
  S <- robust_cusum_fixed(my_data, delta = delta, burn_in = burn_in)
  
  # Find first alarm after anomaly starts
  S_after_change <- S[change_point:length(S)]
  alarm_index <- which(S_after_change > threshold)[1]
  
  if (!is.na(alarm_index)) {
    alarm_time <- change_point + alarm_index - 1
    delay <- alarm_time - change_point
    detection_delays <- c(detection_delays, delay)
  }
  
  if (i %% 100 == 0) {
    cat("Completed", i, "simulations\n")
  }
}

# Results
cat("\n========== SCENARIO 4 RESULTS ==========\n")
cat("Successful detections:", length(detection_delays), "out of", n_sim, "\n")
cat("Average detection delay:", mean(detection_delays), "observations\n")
cat("Standard deviation:", round(sd(detection_delays), 2), "\n")
cat("Minimum delay:", min(detection_delays), "\n")
cat("Maximum delay:", max(detection_delays), "\n")
```
